concepts.name: 带宽仪表
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: desktop application icon for Bandix, a network bandwidth, traffic and device monitoring application for Windows, Linux and macOS.
Produce exactly ONE centered icon, not a sheet, mockup, presentation, or grid. Square canvas. A beautifully finished rounded-square app tile takes up about 88% of the canvas, with genuinely transparent empty margin outside it. Bold, minimal geometry, balanced negative space, refined professional software branding, crisp silhouette legible at 24–32 px. Flat vector-like design with just restrained tonal depth. No words, labels, lettering other than any specifically requested monogram. No watermarks, decorative particles, tiny details, external shadows or halo. Clean antialiased edges, absolutely no scattered pixels outside the icon.
Subject: a bold turquoise open semicircular speedometer arc with a single white diagonal needle and a small central pivot, subtly suggesting a network throughput meter. The needle and arc have generous stroke widths and rounded ends; no numerals, no ticks, no secondary charts. Deep midnight blue rounded-square tile, turquoise-to-sky-blue arc, white needle. Modern precise geometric composition, centered and generous size.
